replies.author: Ok_Potential359
replies.body:
You picked the most dull and expressionless model to advertise your thing. You literally could've achieved the same thing with an AI voiceover animating a still picture. This is bad. 

You need to show 'something'.

comments.author: Disposable110
comments.body:
I've shipped a full AI NPC game two years ago, and I can tell you no game company is going to use third party software for this and no gamer is going to pay a subscription fee for it either.

If it's not free, open source and on device, it's not going to work.

And building this in a game with open source tech is pretty trivial if you've already got the talent in house to build a game, which 9 out of 10 times is way more technolocally intense than duct taping whisper, llamacpp and kokoro together for AI NPCs.
